studies.MyoHand: Two simulated trajectories and 200 dependent integration steps establish a recorded input-to-state software response. They supply no trained controller, training corpus or biological ground truth.
studies.historical_other_studies: Retain each earlier study, its denominator, source and withdrawal/repair record; no numerical outcome is recomputed by this reading aid.

original_cue_window.reason: The optical position 50 ms before the cue row was missing in all released trials, so the backward velocity for the first target could not be computed.

post_observation_window.score_aggregation: Equal participant weight, equal trials within participant, equal planned offsets within trial. Squared errors are averaged before taking the square root.
post_observation_window.status: Fixed offline development comparison in a constrained screen-feedback task. Causal preprocessing, live acquisition latency, generalized decoding and clinical use remain unverified.

marsupial_developmental_access.proposal: Antechinus is a proposed marsupial genus for studying development after birth. Specific sites and stages, device burden and recovery remain unresolved.

studies.finding: No mineralized bone detected at birth. Ossification was visible in selected oral, forelimb and spinal elements by the following day.
Skin wound scarring changes with postnatal age.
Researchers induced pluripotency by reprogramming opossum cells in culture.
Later-stage milk was associated with greater weight gain in the cross-fostering comparison. Stomach and small-intestine maturation measures showed no corresponding acceleration.
Maternal antibody transfer and the offspring’s developing immune response have overlapping time courses.

marsupial_developmental_access.open_questions: A natural supply of pluripotent cells, whole-body regeneration, improved implant recovery, and precision control of neural and immune development via milk remain unverified in the proposed Antechinus model.

wrist_pointing_forecast.target: Right-wrist exoskeleton flexion–extension and radial–ulnar angles in degrees.
wrist_pointing_forecast.adaptation: Eligible pointing trials, decoded encoder angles, time and binned angle/voltage features, fitted forecasts.
wrist_pointing_forecast.interpretation: Two comparisons on the same 960 development trials, conditional on the movement history and elapsed cue time. Offline scores do not establish physical instrument timing, biological signal source, population effects or online feedback.

wrist_pointing_forearm_correction.claim_scope: Exploratory reuse of three previously scored DEV participants distinct from training. No sealed test estimates.

kin_mus_uji_wrist.source_cohort: 22 right-handed adults, 26 activities of daily living
kin_mus_uji_wrist.target: Publisher-calibrated glove-derived angles in degrees with a person-specific reference posture and 5 Hz forward-backward filtering.
kin_mus_uji_wrist.emg_units: native archived amplitude scale, voltage conversion unverified

separate_support_limited_release_model.support: At least seven distinct TRAIN people per retained task-time term, task intercept and EMG term. Mapped to identical TRAIN and DEV eligible rows.

kin_mus_uji_wrist.reference_limit: These are exploratory results on held-out development people, with four separate test people unexamined. The forecast interval uses the archived clock. Wrist-axis measurement accuracy, biological signal origin and physical feedback latency remain unverified.

way_eeg_gal_grip_force.evidence: Frozen models scored on three reserved same-study development participants
way_eeg_gal_grip_force.calibration_release_scope: Shown when all three development participants contributed to the force bracket
way_eeg_gal_grip_force.interpretation: Aligned scalp EEG slightly reduced overall mean RMSE against force and motion. The phase-matched rotated control scored lower still, and the EEG branch had higher mean RMSE in the active-target bracket. The study's predeclared EEG utility requirement failed. Three participants constrain the strength and scope of the result. There are no individual results or source waveforms in this package.
way_eeg_gal_grip_force.original_acquisition_acknowledgement: The WAY project (Wearable interfaces for hAnd function recoverY, FP7-ICT-288551) supported the original WAY-EEG-GAL recordings.

hygrip_transducer_voltage.endpoint: Signed released transducer voltage at 120 ms on the stored 50 Hz grid. Errors expressed in mV.
hygrip_transducer_voltage.inferential_scope: Both analyses score three development people. The secondary reuses the primary development observations. The planned directional screens failed. The final cohort remains unopened.

hyser_index_voltage.endpoint: Released index-sensor voltage, 12 ticks ahead on the nominal 100 Hz grid.
hyser_index_voltage.scope: Frozen development evaluation on four distinct people, with separate same-day calibration in TRAIN. Final cohort unopened. Offline released-trace forecasting only.

hyser_next_day_calibration.endpoint: Released index-sensor voltage, 12 ticks ahead on the nominal 100 Hz grid.
hyser_next_day_calibration.scope: Five Day 1 labeled trials per person and fixed Day 2 predictions on released traces. Training assessment uses 12 people and six reciprocal donor pairs. Development reuses four previously scored people and two pairs. Final cohort unopened.

hyser_whole_hand_voltage.endpoint: Released index-sensor voltage, 12 ticks ahead on the nominal 100 Hz grid.
hyser_whole_hand_voltage.scope: Four voltage-only input sets forecast the same released index voltage. Nested training assessment: 12 people, 120 trials and 54,000 windows per arm. Locked development assessment: four previously studied people, 40 trials and 18,000 windows per arm. Final-test records unopened.

hyser_prescribed_task_voltage.endpoint: Released index-sensor voltage 12 ticks ahead on a nominal 100 Hz grid.
hyser_prescribed_task_voltage.scope: Frozen Random-task weights, prescribed trials from 12 fit participants and four development participants outside fitting, all 15 combinations and both index-cue groups.

cemhsey_five_grid_pinch_force.summary: The five-grid profile lowered mean absolute error against all four refitted controls on the new CEMHSEY pinch panel. It beat overall amplitude alone by 0.0081%, with opposite signs on the two indexed days and higher root mean squared error. Adding channel rank persistence fell short of its three-control criterion. The forecast asks for one dynamometer reading 120 ms later on the nominal released force record.

cemhsey_pinch_force_intervals.summary: Giving each cue phase its own force band made all three forecasts' bands narrower on average, with more gauge readings inside and lower interval scores. The check used eight trials from two other people. All six bands covered more than 90% of readings overall and fell below 90% during release.

proposal: Four training groups remain broad neural (brain/spinal/peripheral/relevant visceral), myography, measured motion and physics-generated examples. Myoception includes task-relevant tactile/proprioceptive sensory context; EMG is not an afferent recording. Quantity/diversity scaling remains a testable hypothesis.
